jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Content
jobs.description:
About G2 - The Company


G2 is the world's largest and most trusted software marketplace. When you join G2, you’re joining the industry’s leading team that helps businesses reach their peak potential by powering decisions and strategies with trusted insights from real software users.



Now, we have joined forces with Capterra https://www.capterra.com/, SoftwareAdvice https://www.softwareadvice.com/, and GetApp https://www.getapp.com/ to create the largest source of online data and software insights to fuel intelligent buying in the age of AI. With 200M+ combined annual visitors and 6M verified reviews, we are now the centralized place to enable software buyers to make better and faster decisions with confidence.



And we are just getting started! We are setting out to transform the global B2B software industry and become the most trusted data foundation for buyers and sellers of software for the age of AI.



Does that sound exciting to you? Come join us as we try to reach our next PEAK!



About G2 - Our People



At G2, everything we are and what we do is grounded in our  PEAK values— (Performance + Entrepreneurship + Authenticity + Kindness. Working at G2 means you are part of a value-driven, growing global community that climbs PEAKs together. We cheer for each other’s successes, learn from our mistakes, and support and lean on one another during challenging times. With ambition and entrepreneurial spirit we push each other to take on challenging work, which will help us all to grow and learn.



You will be part of a global, diverse team of smart, dedicated, and kind individuals - each with unique talents, aspirations, and life experiences. At the heart of our community and culture are our people-led ERGs, which celebrate and highlight the diverse identities of our global team. As an organization, we are intentional about our DEI https://company.g2.com/dei and philanthropic work (like our G2 Gives https://company.g2.com/gives program) because it encourages us all to be better people.




ABOUT THE ROLE

G2 has a meaningful Content business, proprietary market evidence, and a trusted customer voice. Today that portfolio spans a range of content, research, and emerging AI-enabled experiences. The opportunity is to turn those assets into a coherent product system - not simply add another content generator.

We are looking for a US-based Principal Product Manager to lead the product strategy across the full portfolio. You will connect customer objectives and G2 evidence to content creation, rights and approvals, distribution, measurement, and activation - while improving the products and customer relationships that already exist.

You will define what belongs in one product, what should remain a connected offer, and how the portfolio evolves without compromising the independence and trust that make G2 evidence valuable. This is a senior individual-contributor role for a product builder with meaningful experience in both content systems and advertising or activation products.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: 

Portfolio and Product Strategy

 - Own the product strategy and roadmap for the full G2 Content portfolio, not only net-new AI products.

 - Define how the current Content portfolio and future capabilities fit together into a coherent customer experience.

 - Translate customer and market demand into clear product bets, sequenced roadmaps, and evidence-based portfolio decisions.

 - Partner with go-to-market, Finance, RevOps, and Legal on rights, packaging, commercial readiness, and responsible experimentation.

AI-Native Content Operations

 - Build the product system that turns G2 evidence and customer objectives into high-quality, reusable content across formats and channels.

 - Apply AI to research, briefing, creation, enrichment, personalization, approvals, distribution, and measurement where it creates real leverage.

 - Create structured content, metadata, provenance, rights, and workflow capabilities that make the output reusable and trustworthy.

 - Design the human-control layer for strategy, taste, claim substantiation, brand safety, and material approvals.

Distribution and Measurement

 - Connect content creation, distribution, activation, and measurement into a coherent customer experience.

 - Use customer and performance signals to improve future product, content, and channel decisions.

 - Run focused discovery and testing to validate customer value before scaling new capabilities.

 - Make measurement clear enough for customers and internal teams to understand what worked and what should happen next.

Trust, Portfolio Leadership, and Commercial Outcomes

 - Protect editorial independence: customers may sponsor, commission, distribute, and activate content, but they cannot buy conclusions, rankings, or favorable independent coverage.

 - Set clear decision rights across Product, Editorial, Research, Creative, Delivery, and commercial teams - preserving editorial independence and accountable product ownership.

 - Align Product, Engineering, Data, Research, Editorial, Creative, Marketing, Revenue, and customer-delivery teams on the end-to-end experience.

 - Define and track a focused set of product, customer, business, and trust metrics.

 - Communicate product tradeoffs, investment needs, evidence, and progress clearly to senior stakeholders.




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

We realize applying for jobs can feel daunting at times. Even if you don’t check all the boxes in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. 

 -  10+ years of product management experience, including Principal- or lead-level ownership of customer-facing products.

 - Demonstrated product experience in both content systems and advertising, adtech, audience activation, or performance-marketing products.

 - Strong product judgment in AI-enabled workflows, data products, audience experiences, and human-in-the-loop controls.

 - Experience consolidating or modernizing a broad portfolio into a sequenced roadmap, migration plan, and shipped outcomes.

 - Proven ability to work across Editorial, Creative, Engineering, Data, Research, Sales, Marketing, and customer-delivery teams.

 - Commercial fluency across software, services, media, or hybrid models, including entitlements, rights, packaging, and pricing.

 - Excellent communication, customer judgment, and cross-functional influence in ambiguous environments.


WHAT CAN HELP YOUR APPLICATION STAND OUT:

 -  Experience with B2B media, content marketing platforms, ad tech, creator tools, or owned-media products.

 - Experience commercializing proprietary data, research, audience, or customer-voice products.

 - Experience with content operations, measurement, rights and provenance, or AI-assisted production workflows.



Our Commitment to Inclusivity and Diversity



At G2, we are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment where people of every background can thrive and feel welcome. We consider applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, genetic information, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, or marital, veteran, or physical or mental disability status. Learn more about our commitments here https://culture.g2.com/commitments.

ABOUT THE ROLE

At G2, our Senior Product Marketing Manager, AI Solutions owns go-to-market strategy and hands-on growth execution for G2 AI Solutions — G2’s full AI product portfolio, spanning G2.ai http://G2.ai (our AI playground and beta testing ground for Blueprints, Agent Evals, and what’s next) all the way through their migration into G2.com http://G2.com. You’ll define who these products are for, build the story that makes buyers care, and personally drive the growth tactics that take an early AI product from zero traction to revenue — owning that GTM motion end-to-end, from first beta signal in G2.ai http://G2.ai to full integration on G2.com http://G2.com. You will report to the Senior Director, Product Marketing, with a dotted line into the product organization, and be a key member of the PMM team.

This role owns G2 AI Solutions — G2’s newest, most ambiguous, and fastest-moving product bets — end to end, covering both sides of the merger from G2.ai http://G2.ai (our AI playground) into G2.com http://G2.com, not just work happening in the AI playground. As capabilities like Agent Evals get built directly into G2.com http://G2.com, this person owns how the audience, story, and growth motion travel with them.

You’ll be a dedicated PMM partner for G2 AI Solutions, embedded in product roadmap and planning from the earliest stages, while also working directly with the builders behind individual solutions underneath it.

This is a blend of strategist and operator: you form a sharp point of view on audience and positioning, and you’re also comfortable rolling up your sleeves to run the campaigns, community plays, and early pipeline motions that get a new product to its first dollar of revenue.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: 

GTM Vision & Market Definition (25%)

 - Define who each AI product is for and why, and build positioning and messaging that’s differentiated and defensible — testing assumptions fast through lightweight experiments, customer conversations, and early pilots.

 - Own GTM strategy for G2 AI Solutions end-to-end — from G2.ai http://G2.ai (Blueprints, Agent Evals, and what’s next) through their migration into G2.com http://G2.com — with a buyer-first lens; seller-facing use cases are secondary and in service of seeding buyer adoption.

 - Own the plan for how each product’s audience, messaging, and channel strategy evolves as it migrates from G2.ai http://G2.ai into G2.com http://G2.com — including products like Agent Evals that are launching directly into G2.com http://G2.com.

Growth Execution & Zero-to-Revenue (20%)

 - Personally own and run the growth tactics that take AI Solutions products from early access to revenue-generating — campaigns, community seeding, lifecycle nurture, and early pipeline generation — not just briefing others on what to build.

 - Own pipeline and revenue visibility for the AI Solutions portfolio in its early stages, and run lightweight acquisition and activation experiments (organic, community-led, referral) to find what moves users from aware to paying.

 - Partner with Sales and RevOps to define what “revenue-ready” looks like for an early-stage AI product, and drive the handoff from PMM-led growth to a scaled GTM motion.

Early User Research & Market Validation (15%)

 - Proactively identify and engage prospective buyers before a product is ready, running lightweight discovery — user interviews, concept tests, early-access pilots.

 - Stay close to the competitive landscape and category trends; feed market perspective back to Product as the informed voice of the buyer.

 - Build and maintain a network of early users and prospective customers who can give honest, ongoing input as AI Solutions products evolve; synthesize findings into clear takeaways on who’s likely to buy and what’s resonating.

Sales Enablement & Go-to-Market Readiness (15%)

 - Partner with Sales Enablement to understand what’s landing in the field and close gaps quickly with the right narrative, proof points, and collateral.

 - Use G2’s existing seller and customer base to seed early adoption of AI Solutions products, rather than building net-new external communities from scratch.

 - Brief the PMM team on what enablement materials need to exist across Buyer, Seller, and Reviewer audiences, and serve as a strategic driver behind early pilot and launch motions.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Orchestration (15%)

 - Serve as Products' dedicated PMM partner for AI Solutions — embedded in product org’s roadmap and planning from the earliest stages — while also partnering directly with the builders of individual solutions underneath it.

 - Translate early and often-unformed product direction into a GTM plan the PMM team can execute against; build frameworks and messaging together with PMM peers, then partner with Demand Gen, Content, and Comms to execute.

 - Communicate GTM direction, experiment results, and recommendations clearly to the Senior Director, PMM leadership, and Product; flag when something upstream is broken and bring a proposed solution.

Alignment & Market Intelligence (10%)

 - Give the team clarity on what you’re working toward and why; operate as a reliable, easy-to-trust partner across Marketing and Product.

 - Maintain a current view of the competitive landscape and category trends specific to AI-powered GTM and software discovery, and use it to keep AI Solutions positioning sharp and relevant.

 - Build and maintain a high hiring bar for the PMM function — attracting marketers with intellectual rigor, genuine product fluency, and GTM depth.




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

We realize applying for jobs can feel daunting at times. Even if you don’t check all the boxes in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. 

 -  7+ years of product marketing, growth marketing, or GTM strategy experience in B2B SaaS, including at least one experience getting a product off the ground with little to no playbook.

 - Proven ability to take a product from zero to revenue — hands-on experience running growth or demand campaigns, building pipeline, and driving early revenue, not just strategy and orchestration.

 - Experience in an early-stage or new-product environment (startup, internal venture, or skunkworks team) where you had to define the market as much as the message.

 - Comfortable with data and experimentation: you understand testing frameworks, know how to build and validate a hypothesis, and use data to build a compelling story.

 - A natural relationship builder who gets things done through people — across Marketing, Sales, Product, and Leadership. History of relationships strong enough that people at past companies would say you made their work better.

 - Clear, confident communicator — you write sharp positioning, give a crisp verbal brief, and make meetings productive.

 - Comfortable in ambiguity — you don’t need a fully-formed brief to get started, you help create it.

 - Deep familiarity with or genuine curiosity about AI and how it’s reshaping software buying behavior.

 - Experience with PLG or self-serve motions where understanding the buyer deeply was essential to acquisition.

 - Comfortable owning a broad, evolving portfolio (multiple AI products at different maturity stages) rather than a single, narrowly-defined product.

Travel: Willingness to travel for company events, product offsites, and customer-facing meetings as needed.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Reviews are one of G2's most important assets, but the next chapter is not simply about collecting more of them. It is about expanding beyond the review into broader User Generated Content (UGC) while also improving coverage, quality, freshness, trust, and usefulness.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to own that product system end to end. You will set the strategy for the reviewer and contributor experience, collection across our owned ecosystem and partners, new forms of UGC, and the product capabilities customers use to activate that content. You will determine how G2 identifies coverage gaps, collects better evidence, verifies credible contributions, applies AI without weakening authenticity, and makes UGC more useful across customer workflows and the buying journey.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for a builder who can simplify an ambiguous problem, align teams around the few outcomes that matter, and stays close enough to the work to ship and learn.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: 

Reviews Strategy, Trust, and Quality

 - Own the product strategy and roadmap for G2 UGC.

 - Define the signals and systems that improve relevance, recency, completeness, authenticity, and decision value.

 - Define and operationalize coverage and recency standards that reflect the needs of different product segments rather than applying one arbitrary threshold everywhere.

 - Make explicit tradeoffs among coverage, volume, quality, cost, and speed rather than treating review count as the only outcome.

 - Partner with Research, Data, and AI teams on quality measurement, trust signals, moderation, and safe use of AI.

Contributor Experience and Collection

 - Own the product journey from an invitation landing through contribution, verification, approval, publication, and reuse - while partner teams own their acquisition campaigns and reviewer operations.

 - Build adaptive collection experiences that use context, dynamic questions, and AI assistance to make contribution easier and the resulting evidence better.

 - Define the product requirements for offsite, embedded, event-based, and "review now, verify later" collection; partner with the Ecosystem team on reusable integration infrastructure.

 - Design and test incentive and value-exchange models for different contributor and software segments.

 - Instrument the funnel and run disciplined experiments across completion time, accepted-completion rate, cost per accepted review, defects, and time to publication.

Customer Activation and Distribution

 - Own the product capabilities that help customers discover, configure, activate, distribute, and measure reviews and other UGC across their product, marketing, sales, partner, and AI experiences.

 - Turn repeat customer needs into scalable activation capabilities, including reusable surfaces, permissions, integrations, APIs or exports, and performance measurement.

 - Partner with Revenue, Customer Success, Marketing, and Ecosystem teams on repeatable activation patterns, while those teams own adoption programs and commercial execution.

 - Instrument activation from UGC availability through first use and repeat use, connecting product behavior to shared retention and expansion outcomes.

Buyer Value and Product Innovation

 - Connect improvements in UGC supply and quality to discovery, comparison, evaluation, and decision-making experiences.

 - Partner with adjacent product teams to apply trusted evidence and reusable trust primitives to evaluations, comparisons, and AI-native buying experiences.

 - Identify, validate, and scale new forms of UGC beyond written reviews when they create measurable buyer or customer value and close strategic coverage gaps.

 - Stay close to buyers, contributors, and customers so the roadmap reflects real behavior rather than internal assumptions.




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

 -  10+ years of product management experience, including Principal- or lead-level ownership of customer-facing, data-rich products.

 - Experience building contributor-driven, user-generated-content, marketplace, identity, community, or trust products at meaningful scale.

 - Strong command of product discovery, funnel instrumentation, experimentation, incentive design, and behavioral loops.

 - Sound judgment about where AI improves a workflow and where human trust, verification, or control must remain.

 - A track record of connecting data quality and product mechanics to customer and business outcomes.

 - Proven ability to lead complex work across Engineering, Design, Data, Research, Operations, and go-to-market teams without relying on formal authority.

 - Clear, direct communication and a willingness to make difficult prioritization decisions in ambiguous environments.




WHAT CAN HELP YOUR APPLICATION STAND OUT:

ABOUT THE ROLE

G2’s data becomes more valuable when it helps customers make better decisions and works inside the systems they already use. We are looking for a Principal Product Manager who combines technical expertise with strong business acumen to help grow our Data Solutions business and lead the ecosystem of APIs, integrations, partner capabilities, and MCP- and agent-enabled workflows that brings G2 data to market.

You will own the product strategy and roadmap that supports four broader business goals: Data Solutions revenue and pipeline growth; customer MCP adoption and usage; expansion of MCP surface area through partners; and integration cleanup and migration. Your contribution will vary by goal—sometimes through direct ownership of product capabilities and migration work, and sometimes through close partnership with commercial, Partnerships, Data, and Engineering leaders.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who can lead product strategy and work directly with code. You should be able to translate business use cases into technical builds, prototype API or MCP integrations and ship targeted code when that is the fastest way to validate an approach or unblock delivery while engineering remains accountable for production architecture, quality, reliability, and sustained implementation.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: 

Ecosystem Strategy and Product Architecture

 - Own the strategy and roadmap for how G2 data is exposed and activated through APIs, MCP, strategic integrations, and developer and partner surfaces.

 - Own the integration hub service, developer portal, and public-facing surfaces used by Marketing Solutions customers, Data Solutions customers, and partners, including the health, rationalization, and migration of the integration portfolio.

 - Define the platform capabilities that should be built once and reused across customers, partners, and use cases.

 - Work with Partnerships to identify the partners that can most effectively expand MCP surface area and customer value, while deciding whether each use case belongs in MCP, an API, or a more custom integration.

 - Prioritize investments using customer evidence, revenue opportunity, partner readiness, technical leverage, and strategic differentiation.

 - Make clear build, buy, partner, and defer decisions.



Technical Discovery and Delivery

 - Work closely with Engineering and Data teams on APIs, data contracts, authentication, permissions, reliability, and developer experience.

 - Prototype integrations and ship targeted code when doing so accelerates learning, proves an approach, or unblocks delivery.

 - Create reusable patterns that let other G2 product teams safely expose their workflows through MCP without the Ecosystem PM owning every product-specific use case.

 - Translate technical constraints and architecture choices into clear customer and business tradeoffs.

 - Stay close to implementation details without losing accountability for the product strategy and outcome.



Data Solutions Product Strategy and Growth

 - Own the product roadmap supporting Data Solutions revenue and pipeline growth, aligning customer needs and market opportunities with new business, retention, and expansion priorities.

 - Build a deep understanding of how investors, financial institutions, AI labs, and other Data Solutions customers use G2 data, what drives its value, and where unmet needs create opportunities to grow.

 - Partner with Data Solutions commercial leaders to shape new offerings and improve existing ones, including recommendations on data coverage, packaging, pricing, delivery options, and customer experience.

 - Support priority customer opportunities through discovery, technical evaluation, and pilots, helping customers validate the value of G2 data and turning repeatable needs into scalable product capabilities.

 - Work with Engineering and Data teams to improve the quality, coverage, freshness, documentation, and delivery of data based on the needs of priority customer segments.

 - Partner with account teams to identify adoption barriers, renewal risks, and expansion opportunities, translating those insights into clear roadmap priorities.

Partnerships and Integrations

 - Turn repeated commercial and partner needs into productized capabilities rather than bespoke commitments.

 - Define product requirements and launch plans for partner-enabled MCP capabilities and integrations that materially improve customer workflows or expand G2’s distribution.

 - Lead the cleanup and migration of legacy integrations with clear ownership, customer communication, deprecation plans, and paths to the future-state architecture.



Product-Revenue Connectivity

 - Create a shared planning and feedback loop across Product, Revenue, Partnerships, Customer Success, and Marketing.

 - Give commercial teams a simple, accurate view of current capabilities, roadmap intent, dependencies, and tradeoffs.

 - Balance near-term customer and partner needs with a durable platform strategy.

 - Define the role’s product contribution across Data Solutions revenue and pipeline, customer MCP adoption and usage, partner-expanded MCP surface area, integration migration progress, reliability, retention, renewal influence, and expansion.




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

We realize applying for jobs can feel daunting at times. Even if you don’t check all the boxes in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. 

 -  10+ years of product management experience, including senior ownership of technical B2B products, platforms, APIs, data products, or integration ecosystems.

 - Strong fluency in APIs, authentication, real-time and batch data delivery, integration architecture, developer workflows, and MCP.

 - Ability to read and write code well enough to prototype integrations, inspect implementation constraints, and ship targeted changes when appropriate.

 - A track record of turning ambiguous customer, partner, and commercial demand into focused product strategy and reusable capabilities.

 - Experience leading 0-to-1 technical products and evolving them into stable platforms.

 - Proven ability to work across Engineering, Data, Partnerships, Revenue, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders with competing priorities.

 - Demonstrated experience growing a B2B data or technical product business through customer discovery, offering development, and close partnership with commercial teams.

 - Clear communication and strong judgment about when to move quickly, when to standardize, and when to say no.




WHAT CAN HELP YOUR APPLICATION STAND OUT:

 - Experience with data licensing, commercial data products, or customers such as investors, financial institutions, and AI labs.
